title: Carelinx
summary: Making healthcare scheduling simple, accessible, and patient-first.
overview: Carelinx is a healthcare platform that enables patients to easily book clinic appointments based on their specific needs. Users can browse clinics, compare doctors, view availability, and select convenient time slots  creating a smooth and transparent booking experience. We designed both the patient-facing flows and the back-office dashboard, focusing on accessibility, trust, and clarity. Our approach involved user journey mapping, competitive analysis of telehealth platforms, and testing multiple scheduling scenarios to ensure usability across diverse user groups.
problem: Patients struggled with fragmented, phone-based clinic booking systems that lacked transparency.
approach: End-to-end scheduling platform with patient booking flows, doctor discovery, and a clinic management dashboard.
outcome: 60% Faster Booking · 35% No-Show Reduction · 50% Less Admin Work

title: MediBot AI
summary: RAG-Powered Medical Chatbot System for Healthcare Providers.
overview: MediBot AI is an advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) chatbot designed specifically for healthcare professionals. It securely ingests thousands of medical documents, clinical guidelines, and patient histories to provide instant, accurate, and source-backed answers to complex medical queries. By grounding the AI's responses in verified medical literature, MediBot AI drastically reduces hallucination risks and empowers doctors to make faster, evidence-based decisions at the point of care.
problem: Doctors spent too much time searching through fragmented medical literature and patient histories.
approach: A secure, HIPAA-compliant RAG chatbot that provides instant, source-backed answers to complex clinical queries.
outcome: 91% Response Accuracy · 40% Hours Saved Weekly · 2s Avg Resolution Time

title: AURA — AI Document Intelligence
summary: Local, offline RAG and LangGraph-powered document reasoning.
overview: AURA (AI Understanding and Retrieval Assistant) is an advanced LLM-powered knowledge extraction and reasoning system built on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and LangGraph workflows. It redefines how users interact with documents by enabling semantic understanding, question answering, and summarization of large PDFs, all executed locally without API limits. By fusing RAG and LangGraph orchestration, AURA sets a new benchmark in retrieval-augmented reasoning, showcasing how locally deployable AI systems can rival enterprise-level intelligence platforms while remaining cost-efficient and privacy-preserving.
problem: Traditional document search lacked context awareness while cloud AI raised privacy and cost concerns.
approach: Modular offline RAG + LangGraph pipeline for retrieval, reasoning, memory continuity, and explainable responses.
outcome: 95% Review Time Reduced · 82% Factuality Lift · 5s Avg Response Time

modules.title: LangGraph Workflow Orchestration

title: CHARM
summary: Chicken Health Assessment and Remote Monitoring via Edge AI.
overview: CHARM (Chicken Health Assessment and Remote Monitoring) is an advanced AgriTech platform that leverages edge computing and computer vision to monitor poultry health in real-time. By deploying YOLOv8 object detection and BoT-SORT tracking algorithms directly on edge cameras within the poultry houses, CHARM continuously analyzes flock behavior, detects anomalies like reduced activity or clustering, and identifies early signs of diseases such as Fowl Pox. This proactive monitoring system alerts farmers instantly, reducing mortality rates and improving overall flock welfare without requiring constant manual inspection.
problem: Manual poultry health checks were slow, subjective, and difficult to scale across large flocks.
approach: AI-powered monitoring platform combining real-time detection, disease classification, and automated alerts for farm-wide health visibility.

title: Homii
summary: AI-Powered Real Estate Chatbot for Dubai Property Discovery.
overview: Homii is an intelligent real estate chatbot built specifically for the Dubai property market. It aggregates thousands of scraped property listings and enables users to discover their ideal apartment through natural conversation. Users simply describe what they need — budget, bedrooms, location preferences — and Homii instantly filters and presents matching properties within a 5 km radius. What sets Homii apart is its deep amenity-aware filtering: users can prioritize proximity to gyms, grocery stores, schools, parks, and other amenities. Powered by real-time Google Maps integration, Homii calculates actual walking/driving distances and ranks properties as Best Match, Good Match, or Weak Match based on how well they align with the user's lifestyle priorities.
problem: Dubai's property market is overwhelming — thousands of listings with no easy way to filter by lifestyle needs like proximity to gyms, groceries, or schools.
approach: An AI chatbot that scrapes live listings and uses Google Maps integration to rank and filter properties within 5 km based on amenity proximity and user preferences.
outcome: 90% Search Time Reduced · 5km Proximity Radius · 3s Avg Match Time

overview: An AI safety and auditing platform that improves trust and reliability in LLM-based systems through dual-layer threat protection and human-in-the-loop governance.
